body: Learn what automatic calibration removes from daily operation on the Mettler Toledo MA204.

Analytical balances drift with temperature and time, and keeping one accurate normally means periodic manual calibration with external reference weights, a task that eats time and depends on the operator doing it consistently. MA204's internal adjustment handles that automatically, calibrating the balance using a built-in reference mass rather than requiring external weights or manual intervention.
That matters most in a busy lab where the balance sees continuous use across multiple operators, adjustment happens reliably in the background, rather than depending on someone remembering to run it.

sections.tabSummary: What LA204's two built-in apps actually do
body: What LA204's two built-in apps take off a routine lab's plate.

Counting small components by hand is slow and error-prone past a handful of pieces, and weighing anything that shifts, settles, or breathes on the pan, powders, granules, or restless small samples, makes the reading drift before it stabilizes. LA204's two built-in apps are built around exactly those two everyday problems.

The piece counting app establishes an average unit weight from a reference sample, then converts any weighed batch into a piece count automatically. The dynamic weighing app takes repeated readings over a short window and calculates a stable average, so an unsettled sample still returns a trustworthy result instead of a fluctuating one.

body: What FACT adjustment and leveling guidance actually remove from getting MR204 set up correctly.

An analytical balance that isn't level reads wrong before a single sample even touches the pan, and getting it level by eye, watching a bubble indicator and adjusting feet by feel, is easy to get slightly wrong without noticing. FACT, MR204's automatic internal adjustment, monitors conditions and triggers a self-calibration using a built-in reference mass whenever it's needed, rather than waiting for a scheduled manual check or an operator who remembers to run one.

body: What SmartPan actually does when a sample crosses from micro-scale into everyday range.

A single-range analytical balance forces a choice: fine enough for micro-scale samples, or capable of everyday capacity, but rarely both without buying two instruments. That's a real problem for a pharma lab weighing a wide spread of sample sizes across a single day, from milligram-level actives to gram-level excipients.

MX205DU's SmartPan technology resolves that by running two ranges on one pan: 0.01 mg readability up to 82 g for micro-scale work, switching automatically to 0.1 mg readability up to 220 g once the sample calls for it. The switch happens without recalibrating or swapping instruments.

body: What a regulated lab actually needs from a balance, and where MX204 delivers it.

A weighing result in a GxP-regulated environment has to survive an audit, not just be accurate in the moment. That means the data trail matters as much as the number on the display: who weighed it, when, on what instrument, and whether the record can be tampered with after the fact. A balance that isn't built for that leaves the audit trail to manual logbooks and printouts, both easy to lose and easy to challenge.

MX204 is built GxP-compliant from the ground up, and connects directly to Mettler Toledo's LabX software, so weighing results move into a controlled, traceable record automatically rather than depending on someone transcribing a number correctly.

body: What durability and access control actually add in a lab that isn't a clean, controlled analytical bench.

A precision balance handling larger, everyday samples usually lives in a busier corner of the lab than an analytical balance: more dust in the air, more chance of a splash, more hands using it across a shift. body: Why MA6002 can weigh more than five times MA1002's capacity without losing a digit of readability.

A common assumption with weighing instruments is that capacity and precision trade off against each other, a bigger balance reads coarser, because that's often true across a manufacturer's full range. It's not true within this specific MA precision line: MA1002 and MA6002 share the identical 0.01 g readability, 7 mg repeatability, and 1-second settling time, on the same 180 x 180 mm pan and the same chassis dimensions.

The difference sits entirely in the internal load cell and calibration range, engineered to handle up to 6.2 kg while holding the same measurement resolution MA1002 delivers at 1,200 g. For a lab choosing between the two, the decision comes down to sample size, not a precision trade-off.

For a lab weighing smaller quantities that need more than 0.01 g accuracy but not full analytical-grade precision, that's the gap MA503 is built to close.

body: What automation actually removes from a routine that repeats trace-level weighing many times a day.

faqs.question: What is the XPR205DUE used for?
faqs.answer: Dual-range analytical weighing that needs both fine 0.01 mg precision and everyday 0.1 mg capacity, with built-in quality-assurance automation.

faqs.question: What does dual-range mean on this balance?
faqs.answer: XPR205DUE switches between 0.01 mg readability up to 81 g for fine work and 0.1 mg readability up to 220 g for everyday capacity, on the same instrument.

faqs.question: Does it have motorized doors?
faqs.answer: Yes, XPR205DUE's doors open and close without operator contact.

faqs.question: Does it level itself automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes, automatic leveling confirms correct setup without relying on manual adjustment.

faqs.question: Can it use a hanging weighing pan?
faqs.answer: Yes, a hanging weighing pan option is available for samples that don't sit well on a standard pan.

faqs.question: What is the full technical specification?
faqs.answer: The complete data sheet, including repeatability, minimum weight, dimensions, and interfaces, is available from Inkarp on request.

faqs.question: Is it LabX compatible?
faqs.answer: Yes, XPR205DUE supports network integration and LabX connectivity for connected, traceable data.

faqs.question: What is the price of the XPR205DUE in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the configuration and accessories required.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the XPR205DUE in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Mettler Toledo XPR205DUE in India.
